records.source: That function keeps the caller's order but *drops* keys it cannot resolve, so when everything resolves the answer is a zip and costs one scan. When some keys miss, the returned list is a subsequence and no longer lines up, so the range is bisected: each half is asked separately until a half is either fully resolved (zip it) or a single key (resolve it or record the miss). That is a handful of extra scans for a handful of missing crops, rather than one scan per key.
records.context: That function keeps the caller's order but *drops* structured-data names it cannot resolve, so when everything resolves the answer is a zip and costs one scan. When some structured-data names miss, the returned list is a subsequence and no longer lines up, so the range is bisected: each half is asked separately until a half is either fully resolved (zip it) or a single structured-data name (resolve it or record the miss). That is a handful of extra scans for a handful of missing extracted image regions, rather than one scan per structured-data name.
records.translation: Þessi aðgerð heldur röð köllunar aðila en *detur* á nafn á uppbyggðum gögnum sem það getur ekki leyst, Svo þegar allt leysist er svarið zip og kostar eitt skönn. Þegar einhver nöfn á uppbyggðum gögnum vantar, er listinn sem skilað er undirsequens og raðast ekki lengur saman., svo bilið er skipt í tvennt: Hver helmingur er spurður sérstaklega þar til helmingurinn er annaðhvort fullkomlega leystur (sauma hann) eða eitt nafnið á uppbyggðu gagnaformi (búið að leysa það eða skrá missa). Þetta eru nokkur aukaskönn fyrir nokkur vantar útdregna myndasvæði, frekar en einn skönnun á nafn uppbyggðra gagna.

records.label: spacr.power_simulate#20
records.source: **Well dropout from too few imaged cells** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``). A well where the microscope found three cells enters the fit as one observation next to a well with four hundred. Its positive fraction can only be 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1, and its standard error is several times the classifier's whole signal gap. The Poisson offset stops it dominating the scale of the fit; it does not stop its read-fraction covariate being paired with noise. Dropping such wells is what an analyst does by hand, and it costs wells — so which way the trade comes out is a thing to simulate rather than assert.
records.context: **Well dropout from too few imaged cells** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``). A well where the microscope found three cells enters the fit as one observation next to a well with four hundred. Its positive fraction can only be 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1, and its standard error is several times the machine-learning classification model's whole signal gap. The Poisson offset stops it dominating the scale of the fit; it does not stop its read-fraction covariate being paired with noise. Dropping such microplate sample positions is what an analyst does by hand, and it costs microplate sample positions — so which way the trade comes out is a thing to simulate rather than assert.
records.translation: **Vellur hefur of fáa myndaða frumur** (:func:`drop_low_cell_wells`, ``min_cells_per_well=``). Vellur þar sem smásjáin fann þrjár frumur fer inn í aðlögunina sem ein athugun við hlið vellis með fjögur hundruð. Jákvæð hlutfall þess getur aðeins verið 0, 1/3, 2/3 eða 1, og staðalvilla þess er mörgum sinnum meiri en heill merki gap vélarnáms flokkunarlíkansins. Poisson-breytingin hindrar það ekki að stjórna mælikvarða aðlögunarinnar; hún hindrar ekki að hlutfall lestrarins sé parað við hávaða. Að sleppa slíku sýnishorni af gerð microplate er eitthvað sem greiningaraðili gerir handvirkt, og það kostar sýnishorn af microplate – svo á hvaða hátt viðskiptin þróast er eitthvað sem þarf að herma eftir frekar en staðfesta.

records.label: spacr.power_model.scan_parameters#3
records.source: **Resuming.**  With ``progress_file``, each completed row is appended to a TSV immediately, so a killed sweep loses at most the point it was on.  Re-running with ``resume=True`` (the default) reads the file and skips points whose ``run_key`` is already there.  The key is a digest of the parameter *values*, the replicate, the seed and the backend -- not the row number -- so extending or reordering the grid does not invalidate finished work.
records.context: **Resuming.**  With ``progress_file``, each completed row is appended to a TSV immediately, so a killed sweep loses at most the point it was on.  Re-executing with ``resume=True`` (the default) reads the file and skips points whose ``run_key`` is already there.  The structured-data name is a digest of the parameter *values*, the replicate, the seed and the backend -- not the row number -- so extending or reordering the grid does not invalidate finished work.
records.translation: **Endurtekning.** Með ``progress_file`` er hver lokið röð bætt við TSV skrá strax, þannig að ef framkvæmd er stöðvuð tapast hámark eitt punktur þar sem hún var stöðvuð. Endurkeyrsla með ``resume=True`` (sjálfgefið) les skrána og sleppir punktum sem ``run_key`` er þegar til staðar. Nafn uppbyggðs gagna er samantekt af gildum *parametranna*, afriti, fræi og bakendi -- ekki röðartali -- svo að framlengingu eða umraðanir á grindinni ógildi ekki lokið starf.
